title: Piper PA-28R-201 Arrow — Emergency Procedures (independently worded)
description: Emergency procedures for the Piper PA-28R-201 Arrow. Memory items are marked and should be committed to memory for execution without checklist reference when time does not permit. The Arrow has a hydraulic retractable gear system with an automatic gear extension feature that lowers gear below a threshold airspeed — be aware this may activate during an emergency descent. Manual gear extension is available and detailed here. The Lycoming IO-360 is fuel-injected; there is no carburetor — the alternate air section addresses induction system blockage instead. All numerical limits must come from the specific aircraft POH. These procedures do not substitute for recurrent emergency training.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the PA-28R-201 type. Numerical limitations are deliberately absent.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities or other limitations — must come from aircraft POH.
Equipment variations exist across this model/variant. Verify items against the specific aircraft before use.

rights.notes: Manufacturer POH remains under copyright. This file does not reproduce its wording or selection of items.

sections.title: Engine Failure on Takeoff — Before or At Liftoff

items.text: Brakes — apply firmly to stop on remaining runway
Gear — if briefly airborne with insufficient altitude for return to runway
items.response: LEAVE DOWN; LAND STRAIGHT AHEAD ON AVAILABLE SURFACE
items.detail: Do not attempt a turn back to the runway at low altitude. Land ahead or within 30 degrees of runway heading.

items.text: Flaps — if airborne over suitable terrain
items.response: AS REQUIRED TO REDUCE LANDING SPEED ON AVAILABLE SURFACE
PER POH — TRIM FOR HANDS-OFF GLIDE

items.text: Landing area — identify best available field or airport; begin turn toward it
Fuel selector — switch to opposite or fullest tank

items.response: IN AND LOCKED — open primer causes fuel starvation
ADVANCE TO CHECK FOR FUEL FLOW RESPONSE
OPEN — if induction blockage or icing suspected

items.text: Engine restart attempt — if altitude and identified cause permit
items.response: FOLLOW POH RESTART SEQUENCE; DO NOT WASTE ALTITUDE IF LOW

items.text: Mayday — transmit on 121.5 MHz or last assigned frequency
If engine does not restart — proceed to Forced Landing section

items.response: FULL OPEN — depletes residual fuel from induction system
ALL CLOSED — prevent smoke and fumes from entering cabin
INCREASE TOWARD VNE TO STARVE FIRE OF OXYGEN — PER POH GUIDANCE

items.text: Declare emergency — 121.5 MHz or last ATC frequency
Gear — extend when landing is assured and airspeed is within gear operating speed per POH
Throttle — briefly open to pull fuel from cylinders if fire is in induction system
Occupants — evacuate immediately via upwind door; move well clear

items.response: DISCHARGE ON FIRE IF SAFE TO DO SO; DO NOT DELAY EVACUATION
OFF — removes battery power from all buses
USE IF SMOKE PERSISTS AFTER POWER REMOVED; AIM AT SOURCE

items.text: Land as soon as possible — declare emergency
Electrical equipment — selective restoration if navigation required
items.response: RESTORE MASTER AND INDIVIDUAL SWITCHES ONE AT A TIME; MONITOR FOR SMOKE RECURRENCE

items.text: Oil pressure gauge — confirm low reading; cross-check oil temperature
items.response: LOW PRESSURE CONFIRMED; TEMPERATURE TREND NOTED

items.text: Power — reduce to minimum required for flight
items.response: POWER REDUCED — LOWER POWER REDUCES OIL DEMAND AND HEAT

items.text: Land immediately — select nearest suitable airport or field
items.response: DIVERTING — ENGINE MAY SEIZE WITHOUT WARNING IF OIL IS LOST

items.text: Airspeed — maintain at or below best-glide speed; prepare for sudden engine failure

items.response: ADVISE ATC OF DIVERSION; SQUAWK 7700 IF WARRANTED

items.text: Engine shutdown — if temperature in red arc or seizure imminent
items.response: SHUT DOWN TO PREVENT FIRE AND RETAIN GLIDE OPTIONS

items.text: Engine roughness or power loss — assess induction system

items.response: OPEN — allows engine to draw unfiltered warm air past blocked inlet
items.detail: IO-360 is fuel-injected; no carburetor ice risk. Alternate air addresses blocked primary air inlet or induction icing in freezing conditions.

items.response: EXPECT SLIGHT POWER REDUCTION ON ALTERNATE AIR — WARMER, LESS-DENSE AIR

items.text: Conditions — exit visible moisture or icing conditions promptly

items.response: RETURN TO RAM AIR AFTER CLEAR OF CONDITIONS AND ENGINE RUNNING NORMALLY

items.text: Best-glide airspeed — establish and trim hands-off
Landing site — select best available: runway, paved road, or open field
items.response: SELECTED; ASSESSED FOR LENGTH, SURFACE, OBSTACLES, AND WIND
7700 SQUAWKED; MAYDAY ON 121.5 OR LAST FREQUENCY — POSITION AND INTENTIONS STATED
OFF BEFORE TOUCHDOWN (unless flaps still needed)
DOWN FOR PAVED OR FIRM SURFACE; CONSIDER UP FOR ROUGH OR SOFT TERRAIN TO REDUCE FLIP-OVER RISK

items.text: Flaps — extend as needed to reduce approach speed
items.response: FULL OR APPROACH SETTING PER POH IF ADEQUATE ALTITUDE REMAINS

items.text: Touchdown — aim for first third of available area; land into wind; wings level
Gear-unsafe horn — note conditions; do not assume false indication until investigated
Airspeed — confirm below maximum gear operating speed per POH
Gear handle — cycle DOWN; confirm fully seated
Indicator lights — check all three legs
items.response: NOTE WHICH SHOW GREEN, AMBER, OR NONE; CONSULT POH

items.text: Circuit breakers — gear indicator and hydraulic pump
items.response: CHECK; RESET IF TRIPPED — ONCE ONLY

items.text: Maneuver — coordinated turns; sideslip may dislodge hung leg per POH guidance
Manual extension — if electrical or hydraulic failure
items.response: PROCEED TO EMERGENCY GEAR EXTENSION SECTION

items.text: ATC — advise tower; request emergency equipment standby; request low pass for visual gear confirmation
Airspeed — slow below maximum gear extension speed per POH

items.response: CHECK; RESET IF TRIPPED; CONFIRM PUMP OPERATING

items.text: Manual extension control — locate per POH; operate per POH procedure
items.response: OPERATED PER POH STROKE COUNT OR UNTIL INDICATOR CONFIRMS DOWN
items.detail: Location and method of manual extension varies by aircraft serial number and modification status. Know your specific aircraft before flight.

items.text: Automatic gear extension system — note it may have already deployed gear as airspeed decreased
items.response: CONFIRM CURRENT GEAR STATE BEFORE MANUAL PUMP ACTION
THREE GREEN — if not all green, consult POH for partial-gear or belly-landing guidance

items.text: Land as soon as possible on longest available runway
items.response: EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT STANDING BY; LANDING EXECUTED
